consumers_inspected: artifact build/load and inference context fastpath
exclusions: Not a complete audit of every noncausal decoder, survival/tuning helper or custom injected distribution
No fixes or new fitting in this audit

findings.issue: Continuous Gaussian/Student-t locations are silently clipped using categorical MAX_LOGITS=100000, breaking translation equivariance and zeroing gradients above the cap.
findings.reproduction: Move both x and means from near0 to near1000000. Effective means become100000, likelihood changes drastically, and mean/loc gradients are exactly zero.
findings.impact: Affects both continuous emission families on unscaled large positive inputs. The scaled five-feature baseline did not reach the cap; native raw-price input can be exposed.
findings.recommendation: Separate finite validation of continuous locations from categorical logit stabilization; add large-offset translation and gradient tests.

findings.issue: Valid exact-zero duration support produces NaN gradients.
findings.reproduction: log_p=[[[0,-inf,-inf]]] requires_grad; backpropagate sum(exp(log_end))+sum(exp(log_continue)). All log_p gradients are NaN.
findings.impact: Public differentiable hazard use with permitted impossible durations is unsafe. Positive-support gradcheck passes. No evidence that the ordinary finite-logit baseline exercised this failure.

findings.issue: probs=[0,.4,.6] yields finite log_prob(1) but all-NaN probability gradients.
findings.cause: Taking log of exact-zero normalized probability before gather creates undefined backward paths.
findings.impact: Probability-parameterized categorical API is unsafe on simplex boundaries; current default model likelihood uses logit-based matrices rather than this path.

findings.issue: Advertised broadcasted batch/event shapes disagree with moments/entropy.
findings.reproduction: loc=zeros(2,3), scalar scale=1,df=5,event_dim=1 returns scalar entropy 1.62750 instead of batch [4.88251,4.88251]. Scalar loc with scale=ones(2,3) returns scalar mean instead of [2,3].
findings.impact: Standalone distribution API failure; model emission path expands parameters and passed reference checks.

findings.issue: Finite NEG_INF mask sentinel ceases to enforce hard support at saturated logits.
findings.reproduction: Float64 logits filled -1e40 clamp to float32 minimum; forbidden and allowed categories both get the same finite value. Masked probabilities become [.5,.5] despite one category forbidden.
findings.impact: All three categorical model distributions share the weakness. Extreme finite-input case, not observed baseline behavior.

findings.issue: validate_args=True raises AttributeError before parameters are initialized.
findings.impact: Standard validation entry point unusable; default False bypasses it.

findings.issue: Scalar labels do not broadcast across a batched categorical distribution.
findings.reproduction: Batch logits shape[2,3], scalar value1: PyTorch returns shape[2], custom implementation raises expand RuntimeError.

findings.issue: soft_dmax is accepted via kwargs but ignored by expected_probs and forward; log_matrix applies it.
findings.impact: Generic probability helpers can report a different PMF than model likelihood for the same supplied gate. Active model likelihood correctly calls log_matrix; do not assume a kernel bug.

actual.message: expand(torch.FloatTensor{[2, 3]}, size=[3]): the number of sizes provided (1) must be greater or equal to the number of dimensions in the tensor (2)

emission.covariance: diagonal; conditional independence across feature coordinates

frozen_artifact_inspection.duration_parameterization: softmax(logits/temperature + log(sigmoid(duration_logits_bias))); two additive free age-score terms

training_only_inspection.interpretation: Artifact means remain near uniform initialization after ten updates; this is evidence of weak duration adaptation, not an isolated mathematical bug.

verified: Duration mean remains near uniform D64/h=.5 initialization after ten updates; no convergence claim is justified.
Ergodic boundary transitions permit self-renewal, with diagonal probabilities approximately .229-.281 in the frozen artifact.
The synthetic truth has nonself episode transitions. Model episode age can reset on self-renewal without a regime-state change.

Gaussian emissions are conditionally diagonal. The observed training features have substantial marginal correlation (.778 return/trend, .854 volatility pair). Marginal correlation alone does not prove within-state conditional dependence.
research_interpretation.correction_to_prior_interpretation: The previous capped-age MAE is an exploratory diagnostic, not a directly comparable ground-truth regime-age accuracy metric when self-renewal semantics differ. No frozen score or model was changed.
hypotheses_not_proven: Redundant additive duration logits and log-sigmoid gate scores
research_interpretation.not_concluded: The seven reproduced numerical/API failures have not been shown to cause the finite-logit, standardized Gaussian baseline oversegmentation.

recommended_order: Remove unintended continuous-location clipping, preserving finite checks and all family/translation/gradient invariants.
Fix numerical gradient failures with exact-zero support regression tests.
Fix categorical validation/broadcasting and Student-t broadcasted moment/entropy contracts.
Restore exact hard support or explicitly reject unsupported numerical ranges.
Resolve duration generic-helper gate semantics; align research episode-age meaning before further tuning.
Only then preregister training/validation duration/emission/optimization diagnostics; keep late test frozen.
